title: 第28章 找两个姑娘让他熟悉熟悉！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 秦淮河畔。一辆马车缓缓在河边停下，车帘掀开，漂亮的小丫鬟跳下马车，扶着穿着一身白裙圣洁如仙子的孔诗岚下了马车。孔诗岚下了马车后，又亲自扶着一个戴着斗笠的女孩下了车。“澜儿，你身体不好，想要出来给我说我去接你，陛下又不是不通情达理的人，你这样自己一个人乱跑，陛下会担心的。”女孩正是皇帝最喜爱的高阳公主萧岚。孔诗岚和她自幼一起长大，关系极好，只是萧澜患有肺痨，自幼身体不好，一直被陛下养在宫里，很少与外界接触。这就导致这丫头性格极为跋扈，三天两头就想偷偷溜出宫玩。“我才不要呢，告诉父皇……咳咳……他就告诉我母妃，母妃知道又要哭兮兮，烦死了。”萧澜丝毫不顾自己咳得半死，一蹦一跳拉着孔诗岚往前走：“好了，岚姐姐，别说我了，我听说胭脂楼刚刚研究出了很多胭脂，咱们赶紧去看看。”孔诗岚脸色一变，道：“你身体不好，这东西可不能乱用，不然你又要咳个不停了。”萧澜沉吟了一下，大眼睛眨了眨：“那我就闻闻，我闻闻总可以了吧？岚姐姐，快点走了。”“再晚一点，父皇该来抓我了。”孔诗岚看着女孩俏脸上的哀求和可怜，心还是软了。“行吧，只能看看，你要是敢往嘴上抹，看我怎么收拾你！”胭脂楼，顾名思义是京都最大的胭脂铺，里面收拢了来自整个天下的各种胭脂，位置又在全是青楼的秦淮河畔，因此生意极为红火。只是孔诗岚拉着公主刚刚穿过人流，就遇到抱着手走在前方，正在和一群狐朋狗友吹牛逼的唐逸。四目相对，两人都不约而同停下脚步。梁绍等人看到这一幕，也都跟着停下了脚步。唐逸其实和孔诗岚没有太多交集，前身以前和她见过几次，但没说过话。前几日她霸气去唐家退婚，也没有和他说一句话。但毕竟彼此有可能会成为皇帝下旨赐婚的对象，还是让唐逸感觉有点怪异，那种感觉就像是去嫖被媳妇抓住了一样。莫名有点小紧张。沉默了一瞬，唐逸微微颔首：“孔小姐，好巧，你也来逛青楼？”这话一出，唐逸自己都呆住了，妈的怎么就把心里话说出来了？梁绍柳文彦一群人瞬间都懵了，眼睛都瞪得如铜铃。乖乖，你就是这样和美女说话的？在你面前的，可是号称京都第一美女的孔诗岚，你这第一句话就问人家是不是也来逛青楼？老兄，人家出身名门，各方面都是这个时代女性的翘楚，会做出逛青楼这种事吗？果然，孔诗岚眉心沉了沉，拉着萧岚退到一边：“不敢打扰唐少爷的雅兴，青楼唐少爷还是自己去吧！”“岚姐姐，青楼是对面那个幻音坊吗？”萧澜指着不远处的幻音坊，上面还有好多花枝招展的女人在挥动着手帕呢？“咳咳……岚姐姐，要不我们也去看看？”萧澜拉了拉孔诗岚的手，有点跃跃欲试。孔诗岚吓了一跳，让你一个公主进青楼，你知道多少人被灭口？第一个被灭口的就是我。“试什么试，敢进入那种地方，打断你的腿。”孔诗岚脸色冰冷看向唐逸：“唐大少爷，请带你的朋友离开，我们之间本来就没什么关系，你也没必要做解释。”唐逸一群人再待着，她怕劝不住萧澜。这妮子的倔劲一上来，十头牛都拉不回来。只是这几日刚刚对唐逸积累起来的一点点好感，瞬间就烟消云散了。如此浪荡子，怎么可能是小诗仙！“好吧，那你们早点回去，女孩子大晚上在外面不安全。”唐逸抬手摸了摸鼻，这误会大了。然而这句话一出，唐逸明显察觉到孔诗岚的俏脸更冷了。她冷笑一声，淡漠道：“那就不劳唐少爷担心了！”孔诗岚逮着两步一回头的萧澜走了。梁绍，柳文彦一群人目瞪口呆地盯着唐逸，许久梁绍才没好气道：“不是，有你这么和姑娘说话的吗？你这几句话，句句踩禁区啊老兄！”“那是孔诗岚，京都第一美女孔诗岚，别人想要有机会和她说说话都没有，你这大好的机会就这样浪费了！”“你……你，废柴！”梁绍恨铁不成钢。唐逸脸色有些尴尬，这能怪我吗？老子前世是特种兵，最擅长的就是打打杀杀，谈恋爱哄女人这种事，老子又没有经历过。唯一的一点，就是和电视上学的。“行了，走，去幻音坊。”“今晚，老子不让他破身，老子就不信梁！”梁绍咬牙切齿，他觉得唐逸不会和女人打交道，完全是因为这几年被恶毒后母困在唐家，没有机会和外界接触造成的。今晚，必须让唐逸知道女人的美妙。一群人拥簇着唐逸进幻音坊，甚至已经开始教授他各种姿态了。而在他们身后，一辆马车缓缓驶了过来，车帘掀开，太子看着被拥簇着进幻音坊的唐逸，脸色阴沉至极。“殿下，我们需要等吗？”侍读太监问道。“等？让本宫在青楼外等着他出来？他以为他是谁？他也配？”太子放下车帘，冷声道：“大才？流连于烟花柳巷的大才吗？”“这家伙，不知道使用什么手段骗了父皇罢了。”“回宫！竖子不足与谋！”而这时，唐逸和梁绍等人已经进了幻音坊。“哎哟，梁少爷，您总算来了，姑娘们可都想死你了。”刚进幻音坊，风韵犹存的老鸨就甩着手帕扭着腰走了上来，见到唐逸微微一怔：“哟，这位公子有点面生呀。”唐逸微微颔首，一直被禁足在家，能不面生才见鬼。梁绍拦在唐逸的面前，没好气道：“就是因为太生，才带来你这里熟悉熟悉的。”“赶紧的，好姑娘先给我这兄弟来一打！”“把他伺候好了，本少爷重重有赏！”“当然，要是梅香姑娘有空，那就更好了。”梅香，幻音坊的头号花魁！
content_en: Along the Qinhuai River.A carriage slowly stopped by the river. The curtains of the carriage were opened. The beautiful maid jumped out of the carriage and helped Kong Shilan, who was as holy as a fairy in a white dress, out of the carriage.After Kong Shilan got off the carriage, she personally helped a girl wearing a bamboo hat get out of the carriage."Lan'er, you are not in good health. If you want to come out, tell me that I will pick you up. Your Majesty is not an unreasonable person. Your Majesty will be worried if you run around by yourself like this." The girl is Xiao Lan, the emperor's favorite princess of Gaoyang.Kong Shilan and she grew up together and had a very good relationship. However, Xiao Lan suffered from tuberculosis and was in poor health since childhood. He had been raised in the palace by His Majesty and had little contact with the outside world.This made the girl extremely domineering and wanted to sneak out of the palace to play every once in a while."I don't want it. Tell Father... cough cough... He will tell my mother-in-law. She will cry again when she knows it. She is so annoyed." Xiao Lan didn't care that she was coughing half to death. She jumped up and down and pulled Kong Shilan forward: "Okay, sister Lan, don't talk about me. I heard that Rouge Tower has just researched a lot of rouge. Let's go and have a look." Kong Shilan's face changed.He changed and said: "You are not in good health. Don't use this thing indiscriminately, otherwise you will keep coughing again." Xiao Lan pondered for a moment and blinked his big eyes: "Then I will smell it. Is it okay if I smell it? Sister Lan, leave quickly." "If it's a little later, my father will come to arrest me." Kong Shilan looked at the pleading and pity on the girl's pretty face, and her heart softened."Okay, let's just take a look. If you dare to put it on your mouth, let's see how I deal with you!" Rouge House, as its name suggests, is the largest rouge shop in Kyoto. It collects all kinds of rouge from all over the world. It is located on the bank of the Qinhuai River where there are all brothels, so the business is extremely prosperous.But just as Kong Shilan pulled the princess through the crowd, she met Tang Yi, who was walking ahead with his arms folded and bragging with a group of friends.Their eyes met, and both of them stopped in unison.When Liang Shao and others saw this scene, they also stopped.Tang Yi actually didn't have much interaction with Kong Shilan. His predecessor had met her several times before, but had never spoken to her.A few days ago, she went to the Tang family to break off the engagement without saying a word to him.But after all, there was a possibility that the two of them would become the marriage partners decreed by the emperor, which still made Tang Yi feel a little weird. It felt like he was caught by his wife while going whoring.Feeling a little nervous for no reason.After a moment of silence, Tang Yi nodded slightly: "Miss Kong, what a coincidence, you also come to visit the brothel?" As soon as these words came out, Tang Yi himself was stunned. Why the hell did he say what he was thinking?Liang Shao, Liu Wenyan and the others were instantly stunned, their eyes as wide as bells.Darling, is this how you talk to beautiful women?The person in front of you is Kong Shilan, who is known as the most beautiful woman in Kyoto. In your first sentence, you ask her if she also comes to visit a brothel?Brother, I come from a famous family and am a leader among women of this era in all aspects. Would I do such a thing as visiting a brothel?Sure enough, Kong Shilan's eyebrows darkened, and she pulled Xiao Lan aside: "I don't dare to disturb Master Tang's elegance. Master Tang should go to the brothel by himself!" "Sister Lan, is the brothel the Huanyin Workshop opposite?" Xiao Lan pointed to the Huanyin Workshop not far away, where there were many gorgeous women waving handkerchiefs."Ahem...Sister Lan, how about we go take a look too?" Xiao Lan pulled Kong Shilan's hand, a little eager to give it a try.Kong Shilan was shocked. If you, a princess, enter a brothel, how many people do you know have been silenced?I was the first person to be silenced."What are you trying to do? I dare to enter that kind of place and break your legs." Kong Shilan looked at Tang Yi with a cold face: "Master Tang, please take your friends away. We have nothing to do with each other in the first place, and you don't need to explain." If Tang Yi and the others stayed around any longer, she was afraid that she would not be able to persuade Xiao Lan.Once this girl gets so stubborn, even ten cows can't pull her back.But the little good impression I had accumulated towards Tang Yi in the past few days disappeared in an instant.How could such a prodigal be a little poetry fairy!"Okay, then you go back early. It's not safe for girls to be outside at night." Tang Yi raised his hand and touched his nose. This misunderstanding was huge.However, as soon as these words came out, Tang Yi clearly noticed that Kong Shilan's pretty face became even colder.She sneered and said indifferently: "Then I don't have to worry about Master Tang!" Kong Shilan caught Xiao Lan who took two steps and turned back and walked away.Liang Shao, Liu Wenyan and the others stared at Tang Yi dumbfounded. After a long time, Liang Shao said angrily: "No, how can you talk to a girl like this? These few words of yours are off limits, brother!" "That's Kong Shilan, the most beautiful woman in Kyoto. Kong Shilan, no one else has a chance to talk to her. You just wasted this great opportunity!" "You... you, useless!" Liang Shao hates that iron cannot be made into steel.Tang Yi looked a little embarrassed. Can you blame me?In my previous life, I was a special forces soldier. What I was best at was fighting and killing. I had never experienced such things as falling in love and coaxing women.The only thing is that I learned from TV."Okay, let's go to Huanyinfang." "Tonight, if I don't let him lose his virginity, I won't believe Liang!" Liang Shao gritted his teeth. He felt that Tang Yi didn't know how to deal with women. This was entirely because he had been trapped in the Tang family by his vicious stepmother in the past few years and had no chance to contact the outside world.Tonight, Tang Yi must be made aware of the beauty of women.A group of people gathered around Tang Yi into Huanyinfang, and even started to teach him various postures.Behind them, a carriage drove slowly over, and the curtains were opened. The prince looked at Tang Yi who was being crowded into Huanyinfang, his expression extremely gloomy."Your Highness, do we need to wait?" asked the eunuch."Wait? Let me wait outside the brothel for him to come out? Who does he think he is? Is he worthy?" The prince put down the car curtain and said coldly: "A great talent? A great talent who hangs out in the fireworks and willow lanes?" "This guy, I don't know what means he used to deceive the emperor." "Go back to the palace! Shu Zi is not enough!" At this time, Tang Yi, Liang Shao and others had already entered Huanyinfang."Oh, Master Liang, you are finally here. The girls have missed you so much." As soon as he entered Huanyin Square, the charming old lady walked up with her handkerchief twisted around her waist. When she saw Tang Yi, she was slightly startled: "Oh, this young master is a bit faceless." Tang Yi nodded slightly. He was confined at home all the time, and he would be damned if he didn't face him.Liang Shao stopped in front of Tang Yi and said angrily: "It's because of Taisheng that I brought you here to be familiar with him." "Hurry up, good girl, give me a brother first!" "Take good care of him, I will reward you heavily!" "
title_en: Chapter 28 Find two girls to let him get to know each other!
